reviews.text: The best veterinarian my animals have ever known! Thank you for everything! The administrative staff is also lovely and super competent! Thank you 🩷 …

The doctor gave a terrible diagnosis; due to a lack of information and not reviewing my dog's medical history, my dog's condition worsened. Completely unprofessional.

I absolutely do not recommend veterinarian Andre Viera! He practiced malpractice on my pet and was completely negligent. Unfortunately, after being treated by this gentleman, hours later we had to take him to another hospital in an emergency, where it was already too late for them to save him.

If you truly love your pet, DO NOT bring it to this veterinary clinic.

I highly recommend Dr. André Vieira's Veterinary Clinic and his entire team. Our trust in this clinic has lasted for over 20 years and spans generations: my mother, my grandmother, my aunt, and I entrust them with our dogs and cats without hesitation. Beyond Dr. André's excellence, it's clear that everyone at the clinic truly cares about the animals. We are always received with immense care and affection by everyone. It's a relief to know that our four-legged friends are in such good hands! ☺️🙌🏻

I took my cat to Dr. André Vieira's Veterinary Clinic and I was extremely satisfied with the service. From reception to the consultation, the team was always professional, attentive, and available to answer all my questions, which inspires a lot of confidence.
I took Sara, my beloved Chihuahua, to Dr. André Vieira's Veterinary Clinic, and he treated her with great care.

I highly recommend them! F. fell from the first floor and has no lasting effects from the accident. The care he received over more than a year, the surgeries, and the rehabilitation carried out by Dr. André Vieira were fantastic and saved his life!

Dr. André saved the lives of both my dogs countless times. His diagnoses were always accurate and swift, even when other veterinarians were baffled by the symptoms, allowing them to live long and happy 14 years with a good quality of life.

I highly recommend him.

I had a very good experience with this clinic. Besides their technical knowledge, they always treated my animals with the utmost respect and care, and in excellent conditions, as a good clinic should. I highly recommend them.
Excellent service with great professionalism and dedicated attention to the animals.

The best veterinary clinic in Porto. My dog ​​has been followed at the clinic since I got her, and on two occasions they made quick and accurate diagnoses, capable of saving B's life. I will always be grateful to Dr. André Vieira and the entire team of professionals. A special mention also to the entire administrative team, who are 5 stars.
A leading clinic in Porto. Dr. André Vieira and his team are second to none. Exceptional service.

Without a doubt, a trustworthy place.
Excellent service and treatment!! By far the best clinic.

I haven't had any dogs that haven't been to this clinic.
Excellent professionalism.

Best veterinary clinic in the country.

All our experiences/consultations were marked by the care, friendliness, passion, patience, and professionalism of all the doctors and assistants. I wouldn't entrust my dogs' health to anyone else 💌
The attention I received was excellent. The doctor explained the procedures to me clearly and patiently. I will definitely return!

They are terrible. They put someone else's name on the Siac (dog's registration form), they were negligent with my dogs' passports, they said they would call as soon as they were ready and I never received a call. I called after a week and they told me to pick them up the next day, and to my surprise, they were damaged. I called to resolve the issue and went there again, and instead of replacing them with a new one, the veterinarian wrote that she had damaged the final pages of the passport. This is absurd; any document with an error is automatically redone and canceled anywhere. Did they want to save money? I would have preferred to write it myself then. And I'm still trying to get them to change my dog's Siac to my name. It's been almost a month of this embarrassment. I don't recommend them. If they made a mistake, at least they would have helped.

I, like several members of my family, have had very good things to say about this clinic, but at this moment we have a very different opinion!
On the 12th, I went to the clinic with my two dogs, who were completely healthy, as the veterinarian confirmed during the consultation.
The following day, one of the animals presented with a 12cm (approximately) nodule and was very complaining. When the vaccine was being administered, the doctor noticed from the dog's reaction that she had hurt him, removed the needle, and administered the rest in another location.
After this situation, which was already unpleasant, after a week and a half, both dogs began to show some strange signs. One had very red eyes and the other had clear discomfort in his abdomen, which prevented him from even resting.
As I was worried, I called to report what happened! The man who answered didn't even try to reassure me, he just "yelled," yes! Literally "yelled" at me! Where he told me, "Do you really think the dewormer would cause this in the animals?" The detail is, one of the puppies had already had a reaction to a pipette last year, and for that reason they thought it best to administer it intravenously...
I was just trying to get them to help me understand what was happening! I wasn't rude, nor even aggressive! I just said that after the vaccines they had these various symptoms! And I couldn't even ask if it was a normal reaction and if it would stabilize afterwards. Which leads me to think that the gentleman was more concerned with shirking responsibility than helping to resolve the situation!
This was one of the worst experiences in a veterinary clinic! Lack of empathy and inhumane!
All my girls have come here since they were puppies... and I wouldn't trade them for anything. 🐶🐶🐶 The kindness and care she shows for our animals is fantastic. …
Superficial consultation and few explanations. Several payments and no answers were given.
The staff at the clinic helped me a lot during a very difficult situation. Thank you.

On an initial visit, Dr. André immediately identified hypothyroidism in my senior dog, which explained and helped resolve her weight problem. She underwent two surgeries at this clinic and was always treated extremely well by the entire team. Doctors Joana and Sandrine, and all the nursing staff, are incredibly attentive and caring towards us and the animals. They are a thoughtful team that doesn't suggest tests and interventions "just because," but only when strictly necessary, and always keeps the owners informed.
Very good!
The best in the city of Porto.

Ever since he saved my dog ​​in the middle of the night during an emergency more than 20 years ago, we've never wanted another clinic. Dr. André, and also Dr. Joana, are examples of generosity, humanity, and empathy towards animals and their owners. I've had situations where he was the only one with diagnostic and treatment resources that weren't available in other "veterinary hospitals" in my area. I much prefer making the trip to the other side of the Douro River! A big thank you to the whole team!
Excellent professionals, dedicated and concerned about animals.
